status: Accepted OMF Frame Rate source/interpretation/interlace/independence/presentation/retention rules. Audio Sample Rate and remaining OMF fields under review.

authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Frame Rate rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read audio Sample Rate from OMF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Accepts preceding safely owned typed video SampleRate, shared exact interpretation, no automatic interlace adjustment, audio blank, independence from Length/DF, late labels/exact numeric sorting and compact retention. Starts OMF audio Sample Rate research. No runtime implementation/cutover, Bin Filter change, new header-opening trigger or final cross-source priority table.

agreedBellaRules.scope: OMF Frame Rate proposal only; Duration accepted. No runtime code/cutover, Bin Filter change, new header-opening trigger or reopened full source-priority discussion.
agreedBellaRules.source: Safely qualified physical video file own descriptor MDFL:SampleRate, preserving positive original numerator/denominator and supported typed context under Avid name SampleRate. No master/project/codec/timecode-FPS/audio-rate substitute; no extra master/track corroboration walk. Audio Frame Rate blank.
agreedBellaRules.decode: Known legacy eight-byte ExactEditRate two signed32 words in established numeric order, checked supported type/width/range. Structured numeric, not UTF8/MacRoman. Missing/damaged/conflicting/unresolved/unsupported required rate gives no OMF Frame Rate; retain inventory and other valid facts.
agreedBellaRules.interpretation: Reuse exact Avid video interpreter accepted for OMF Duration, preserving source words. Finite exact decimal aliases and equivalent fractions as already agreed; no approximate snapping, generic-Rational or audio-frequency aliases.
agreedBellaRules.interlaceAndUnits: Known supported frame-based layouts use interpreted own clock without automatic interlace/half-height/raw-enum halving or doubling. Native codec-wrapper and optional presentation helpers have separate contexts; no new generic field-rate recovery/layout scope. Future proven conversion must preserve raw Duration count/unit pair.
agreedBellaRules.independence: A usable Frame Rate does not require usable Length/Duration or DF mode. DF changes numbering, not fps. Unknown relevant rate is blank if no eligible source; do not erase independently valid metadata.
agreedBellaRules.presentationAndRetention: Share existing preserved rate and pure interpreter with Duration. Late familiar labels and exact numeric sorting; no duplicate permanent pair/string solely for this column or label-parsing for maths/sorting. Nominal30 does not replace29.97. Keep compact type/source/availability and release scratch. Uncommon label precision remains existing presentation follow-up.
agreedBellaRules.buildingBlocks: Small C++17 fixed-width fraction/value helpers and checked QtEndian decoding. No new dependency, separate rate parser or additional media read solely for this column.
agreedBellaRules.existingPriority: Usable MDB first; eligible usable own-file header rate only if MDB unusable and header independently already read. No new open or MDB Duration repair from isolated header Frame Rate. Full source table remains deferred.
